name: RC-B10-0415/2025 – § 5 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text: 5.Notes that 1 300 human rights defenders, journalists and other public figures remain in Pakistan under temporary protection; emphasises that Member States retain full sovereignty over their asylum and migration policies and should prioritise national security and border integrity;
